It uses the control pattern from the sibling \u003ccode\u003esqrewdriver/\u003c/code\u003e project as inspiration only; the desktop app, Bun runtime, and Electrobun packaging are not runtime dependencies.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThe controller runs after InspeQtor. A run stops cleanly only when InspeQtor hard gates pass, repair is not requested, required completion files exist in \u003ccode\u003eqodeyard/\u003c/code\u003e, and no current hard validation or stale artifact failures remain. When that gate fails and repair caps allow another pass, it writes \u003ccode\u003everdict/sqrewdriver-repair-brief.v1.md\u003c/code\u003e plus \u003ccode\u003e.json\u003c/code\u003e, augments \u003ccode\u003everdict/repair-plan.v1.json\u003c/code\u003e, and Qrane starts a same-run repair pass. ConstruQtor receives the brief through \u003ccode\u003eQONQ_SQREWDRIVER_REPAIR_BRIEF_PATH\u003c/code\u003e, while \u003ccode\u003erepair-plan.v1.json\u003c/code\u003e remains the structured source for target files, allowed edit paths, and locked files.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eSuccess is therefore artifact-gated: an AI statement that the task is done is not enough without InspeQtor hard-gate evidence.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eCoding Modes\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-coding-modes\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Coding Modes\" href=\"#coding-modes\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eConstruQtor supports three coding strategies via the \u003ccode\u003ecoding_mode\u003c/code\u003e configuration:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003ccode\u003eheredoc\u003c/code\u003e:\u003c/strong\u003e Legacy mode. <p dir="auto">QonQrete is a <strong>local-first, file-based AI software construction system</strong> that runs a structured multi-agent build loop inside a hardened container. It plans work into briqs, generates code in a Qage, reviews the result, and iterates with either <strong>user-gated cheQpoints</strong> or <strong>fully autonomous global-iteration loops</strong>.</p>

<p dir="auto">This repository currently ships three things:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>QonQrete core CLI/runtime</strong>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>qonqrete.sh</code></li>
<li><code>qrane/</code></li>
<li><code>worqer/</code></li>
<li><code>worqspace/</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>VS Code extension</strong> in <code>vscode-extension/</code></li>
<li><strong>IntelliJ / JetBrains plugin</strong> in <code>intellij-plugin/</code></li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">The IDE integrations let you trigger the existing CLI workflow from inside the IDE. They do <strong>not</strong> replace the core runtime.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>v1.4.7</strong> — The current release. v1.4.0 shipped the MLcon Edition (inspection truthfulness, streaming UX, hybrid Venice alignment). v1.4.1–v1.4.5 are IDE-plugin-only patches. v1.4.7 adds core runtime fixes (Fedora SELinux rootless Podman, interleaved validation cross-briq deferral), upgrades default models to DeepSeek V4, and resolves all IntelliJ Plugin Verifier warnings (0 scheduled-for-removal, 0 override-only, 0 deprecated, 0 internal API across 2023.3–2026.2 EAP).</p>
</blockquote>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Execution wiring defaults</strong>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Primary agents remain per-agent configurable; this workspace's live-test config uses DeepSeek for intake/planning/inspection and CodeSeeq only for ConstruQtor.</li>
<li>ConstruQtor default coding mode is now <code>hybrid</code>.</li>
<li>New launcher switch <code>-N/--no-sync</code> keeps outputs in qage/qonstruction paths and skips repo-root sync-back.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>v1.3.0</strong> — Hardened Sandbox, Agent Renames, Legacy Cleanup</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">QonQrete is a deterministic AI coding agent that builds software inside hardened containers. It takes a high-level task, decomposes it into briqs, generates code, reviews the result, and optionally continues into more build/repair passes when the runtime allows it — all locally, all file-based, all yours.</p>
